entry.title: El Rey del Mundo Demi Tasse — Single
experienceTags: Occasion: Short relaxed smoke, afternoon smoke, Cuban comparison
entry.summaryHtml: Cream, cedar, floral tobacco, hay and gentle honeyed sweetness are the projected centre of this slender handmade Cuban. El Rey del Mundo is traditionally one of the softer Habanos profiles, so the Demi Tasse is more likely to win on refinement, aroma and gradual nuance than force. The 4″ × 30 format should give a more complete handmade-cigar experience than a machine-made club while still remaining a genuinely short smoke.
entry.noteHtml: Untasted. Cigar Hut currently lists the Demi Tasse from A$21 with Single, 10 Cigars and Box of 25 options. Strength and Quality are provisional and Flavour remains unrated until personally tasted.
